caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled "Fluency," illustrates the performance scores for four different prompts—labeled V1, V2, V3, and V4—on the GEMBA-SQM scale, with the y-axis representing scores ranging from 97.0 to 100.0 in increments of 0.5. The horizontal axis lists the four prompt variants in the order V1, V2, V3, and V4. Each bar corresponds to a prompt variant and is colored distinctly: V1 is blue, V2 is orange, V3 is green, and V4 is purple. The exact values are labeled above each bar: V1 scores 99.15, V2 scores 98.2, V3 scores 98.5, and V4 scores 97.7. The bars are arranged in ascending order of their values from left to right, with V1 being the tallest bar at 99.15 and V4 being the shortest at 97.7. There is no visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or outlining applied to any of the bars.
